new: These words are created either through rhyming (rímelő ikerszók), where the first consonant alters and the rest stays the same ('csecsebecse', 'ingó-bingó'), or through vowel alternation (magánhangzó-váltakozás), where the consonants stay stable and the vowel changes ('gizgaz', 'limlom', 'hercehurca', 'ímmel-ámmal', 'dirib-darab').
why: the old text sorted gizgaz, limlom and hercehurca as rhyming pairs and ingó-bingó as vowel alternation; gizgaz, limlom, hercehurca and ímmel-ámmal alternate the vowel, csecsebecse and ingó-bingó change the first consonant
